EXPLANATION: The spectrum is dominated by aliphatic C–H stretches at 2870/2954/2997 cm⁻¹ (consistent with GFQ-003) and lacks any OH/NH stretches, favoring a tertiary amide. The weak band at 1690 cm⁻¹ matches an amide C=O stretch, present in candidate 1. Peaks at 1033 and 966 cm⁻¹ fit typical ether/epoxide C–O stretching modes, and the very strong 769 cm⁻¹ band is consistent with CH₃ rocking/ring deformation often seen in small cyclic ethers. No clear halogen-specific features (e.g., strong Si–F at ~1030 or CF₃ patterns) are required, so purely O/N/C functionality in candidate 1 best matches the observed set.
